_comment: Water towers. tower: legs `height`, tank `radius` and `tank` height (metres), how full it starts (`fill`, 0 to 1), `flow` (cubic metres a second out of one hole per square root metre of water over it), `max_holes` that pour at once, `stream_speed_share` (a jet leaves a hole at this share of the speed water would, so it reads as a leak) and `stream_drops` (particles in each jet), the puddle under it: `puddle_film` (metres deep) and `max_puddle_radius` (metres). spots: where towers stand beside the road: `at` metres out from the start, `side` metres from the road's middle (negative: the other side).
